# mgcl_secret (Ephemeral Resource)

Reads every key/value pair of one mgcl Secret as an ephemeral resource, including public and ephemeral KVs. Values exist only in memory during plan and apply: OpenTofu rejects using them where they would be persisted, and the provider never writes them to plan or state. Use `provider::mgcl::secret_value` only for KVs explicitly marked public.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The ephemeral resource reads public and ephemeral KVs during plan and apply.
# OpenTofu keeps these values out of plan and state.
ephemeral "mgcl_secret" "bootstrap" {
  name = "bootstrap"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the mgcl Secret to read. One or more `/`-separated non-empty segments; each segment must equal its `url.PathEscape` form, and the whole name is at most 64 bytes including slashes. Uppercase letters, `.`, `..`, leading `-` or `_`, and other path-safe characters are allowed; characters that `url.PathEscape` encodes (for example spaces, `%`, `?`, `#`, and non-ASCII) are not.

### Read-Only

- `values` (Map of String, Sensitive) Current key/value pairs of the Secret, including public and ephemeral KVs. Empty Secrets return an empty map.
